name: ffiec-cdr
description: Pull bank Call Report and UBPR data from the FFIEC CDR and Federal Reserve holding company filings (FR Y-9C, Y-9SP), look up item names, and export YTD-aware Excel workbooks.
long_description: Exposes the FFIEC CDR Public Web Service (SIS611) as MCP tools: reporting periods, the Panel of Reporters (bank lookup by name, RSSD, FDIC cert), recent filers, parsed Call Report line items, headline bank summaries and multi-period trends, UBPR XBRL facts, and PDF/XBRL/SDF facsimile downloads. Item names from the Federal Reserve MDRM dictionary (bundled, refreshable). Excel export shows income statement items year-to-date as filed and as formula-derived discrete quarters. Reads only. Throttled to stay under the ~2,500 calls/hour limit, with files cached locally. Downloads are cached in a local SQLite database that detects amended filings and re-downloads them, and whole quarters of Call Reports can be loaded from FFIEC bulk-download files with no API calls. Version 0.3 adds Federal Reserve holding company data from the NIC quarterly BHCF files (FR Y-9C consolidated, Y-9SP semiannual parent-only with consolidated assets): holding company search, headline summary with capital and asset quality ratios, multi-period trend with single-quarter derivation, raw MDRM items, and a file importer. The NIC download page blocks scripts, so quarterly files are downloaded in a browser and imported.
